title: Aristodemus of Messene
summary: Raleigh names Aristodemus of Messene in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aristodemus, chosen King of the Messenians after Euphaes, who offered his owne Daughter and afterwards slew himselfe. He is not Aristodemus vnder whom the Heraclidae returned. The one-word title would fold onto aristodemus, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
